behavior: Given the JVM resolvable via JAVA_HOME, the provisioner spawns JDT LS if and only if that JVM's major version is >= 21: at Java 20 it refuses and never spawns JDT LS, at exactly Java 21 it proceeds and spawns JDT LS, and at a higher version (e.g. 25) it also proceeds and spawns JDT LS.
rationale: One condition (JVM major version) deciding a binary outcome (spawn vs. refuse) is a degenerate two-column decision table [INV-PROV-1]; each column's fixture is drawn at the version-21 boundary (just below, at, just above) per the boundary-value discipline, which catches an off-by-one comparison a single fixed Java-17 example alone would miss.
